description: Gives an open public link its time again from now (lifetime_days, or the link's own lifetime when left out), at the same address, or with open_until_ended makes it work until someone ends it. A link that is already open until ended has nothing to renew and is answered as it is. Only the workspace's owners and admins may. A link that ended cannot be renewed: make a new one with share_report.

lifetime_days.description: How many days the link works from now: 1, 7 or 30. 7 when left out. Leave it out when open_until_ended is true.

open_until_ended.description: The link never expires: it works until the person or another owner or admin ends it (end_report_link), like a shared artifact's link. Only when the person asks for a link that stays up; never with lifetime_days.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: renew_report_link
title: Renew a report's public link
